label: Each actual esse bearer admits a finite audit of a particular actual root ancestor
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred. On one fixed q3a4 profile, each actual esse bearer x has a particular actual bearer r and a finite set of audited recipients. Every relation on the fixed roster agreeing with the full incoming lists of ActualEsseCause at those recipients gives r no supplier and a finite directed path from r to x, permitting zero edges when r is x. The root and audited set may vary with x. This is structural availability of a certificate, with no assertion that an observer has performed an audit.
